reasons.D: Medium-length sentences broken by light asides ('I confess', 'so to say', 'I should explain') echo the passage's parenthetical hedges and dry irony without overdoing them.
reasons.B: Period diction and gentle first-person whimsy fit well, but its sentences run a little smoother and more measured than the passage's aside-studded, catalogue-like movement.

reasons.A: Modern, plain and earnest, with a lyrical 'philosophy of the sea' close; it has no asides, irony or period feel, so it reads least like the author.
